name: Mizuhara Ichigo
source:
3rd year high school student.
In place of her parents who have gone on a sudden trip around the world she has to take care of the cafe they own for a year until she graduates.
She's a determined and simple girl who has a clever way of speaking.
She's good at cooking, but not good at making sweets, so she has to ask the other workers to taste test things.

(CV.[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sayaka_Kinoshita]Kinoshita Sayaka[/url])
